pages.phone: RecordLayout: object form (aside) below rentals, children, rates and files.
uxNotes: The record's own edit form sits in the aside while lists fill the main column (inverse of other record pages, e.g. HR, rentals/r).
'+ Schlüssel' creates an object immediately on click (no sheet, no undo besides trash).
'Zurück' (return a key/item) and 'Tarif löschen' run without confirm; 'Tarif löschen' is a ghost red button, not a ⋯ item.
Rate term fields sit in a 3-column grid without a phone breakpoint (grid-cols-3), likely cramped at 360px.
Primary action label changes per object (Mietvertrag anlegen / Buchen / Ausleihen / Ausgeben), and lendable objects open a sheet while rentable ones open a page.
Three sheet params on one page (?handout, ?several, ?rate) instead of ?new=<thing> / ?edit=<id>.
'Unterobjekt anlegen' (⋯) and '+ <Kind>' / '+ mehrere…' (card) are three paths to add children.

pages.phone: RecordLayout: people, notice, keys, files below the form.
uxNotes: Giving notice (changes the contract end) has no confirm.
Removing a person (red X) has no confirm.
Three separate submit paths on one page: SaveBar for terms/price, immediate buttons for people and notice, header 'Zurück'.
Status 'Storniert' sits in the edit form Choice (a destructive state change saved via SaveBar without confirm).
'Zurück' (rentals.giveBack) means 'take back / return', easily misread as navigation 'back'.
Note textarea uses its placeholder as the only visible label.
Rate can't be changed after create (only shown as card description).
